title: Stealth parity scorecard
description: Measured results from the local stealth probe on 2026-03-10.
notes: This scorecard is intentionally narrow: it covers the stealth probe surface, not every public anti-bot detector.
Permissions are omitted from the spider chart because they passed in all four runs and do not differentiate the profiles.
Measured scores: agent-browser normal 4/7, agent-browser stealth 7/7, Playwright normal 1/7, Playwright stealth 6/7.
The Playwright stealth miss came from connection.rtt staying at 50 instead of the probe's expected 100.
